articles.title: Just outside Jupiter, one region may have forged six meteorite parent bodies
articles.desc: When the solar system formed, a disk of gas and dust orbited the young sun. Some grew into planets, while the rest are considered to be the precursors of today's asteroids. Researchers assume that this development did not proceed in a linear fashion, with different stages of planetesimal development occurring simultaneously, and not every region of the disk offering favorable "starting conditions" for planetesimals.

articles.title: Inside the fraud-ripe feeding frenzy to snag Anthropic shares while the company remains private
articles.desc: A feeding frenzy in the animal kingdom is, at its core, vicious competition.
